title: 第23章 背刺机制第24章 返回
slug: 老师是个多周目速通玩家
lines: 所有惨叫声都像是复制粘贴的一样，响起来不到两秒钟时间就戛然而止。
这种声音重复了差不多二十次，然后洞窟就彻底陷入了死一般的寂静。
这一幕对还是学徒的宁语以及雾和坤三人来说具有非常恐怖的震撼力。
所谓，未知的才是最值得恐惧的。
现在洞窟里血雾弥漫，自己每一次呼吸都能嗅到浓郁的血腥味，死亡的气息不仅沁入他们肺部，也附着在他们体表的每一寸肌肤。
而他们并不知晓，安静下来的血雾中，还活着的究竟是自己人，还是那些狰狞可怕的龙飨信徒。
咔嚓…
咔嚓……
血雾弥漫的洞窟里，开始传来零碎的脚步声。
那是有人踩踏在碎石地上发出的动静。
雾将刺剑横于身前，护住身后的弟弟，此刻她已经浑身猩红，长发也被鲜血浸透，却连大口喘气都不敢，全神贯注地盯着眼前的血雾。
而相比之下，宁语就镇定许多了。
她回过神来之后，迅速调用星辰符文，运转术法将洞窟内部那浓郁的血雾尽数抽离，随后又燃起符文的光辉，提供照明。
恢复视野的洞窟之内，仅剩下七八名执事团成员还能喘气，他们中大多数人都已经倒地，尚且惊魂未定。
只有领队一人还提着长剑伫立在原地。
他的面具已经碎裂了一半，露出左半边沧桑的脸，以及那的写满心悸的眼眸。
他不知道刚才发生了什么，只知道，有个奇怪的人影闯入了乱战群中，然后就开始有龙飨信徒接二连三倒下。
最令人感到恐惧的是，他们都是被一刀毙命的，且倒下的姿势基本都一样——面部朝下。
此刻视野恢复清晰，领队惊魂未定地环顾四周，才发现所有龙飨信徒身上都只有一道致命伤，就在他们尸体的后背上。
那是刀刃贯穿后心，直接捅了个对穿的效果。
这时候，领队才终于回忆起自己在血雾中看到了什么。
他看到一个人影以极快的速度窜到龙飨信徒的正背后，抽刀背刺，接上一脚踹在对方膝盖窝，顺势拔出刀刃，不再多看尸体一眼，转而闪身到另一名龙飨信徒的背后，重施故技。
然后是第三个，第四个，第五个……
就这么一套动作，重复了二十几次，在短短不到一分钟时间里，把所有龙飨信徒杀了个精光。
在那其间，并非没有龙飨信徒的人对他群起而攻之。
可诡异之处就在于，所有砍向那人的龙骨刃……
都没有奏效！
领队不知道是不是自己看错了。
他明明有注意到那人在对其中一名信徒进行背刺的时候，其他龙飨信徒的龙骨刃有好几次砍到他身上了，但都没能造成任何伤害。
那人就这么如入无人之境，一口气把所有龙飨信徒给屠了个干净。
血雾散去。
领队却迟迟不敢放松自己提剑的那只手。
因为杀光了所有龙飨信徒的人，就是那名死诞者，而此刻他就在尸体丛中兜兜转转，距离自己非常近。
content_en:
"Roar——"
All the screams seemed to have been copied and pasted, and they stopped abruptly in less than two seconds.
This sound was repeated almost twenty times, and then the cave fell into complete deathly silence.
This scene was very terrifying and shocking to Ning Yu, Wu and Kun, who were still apprentices.
It is said that the unknown is the most fearful.
Now the cave is filled with blood mist, and I can smell the strong smell of blood with every breath I take. The breath of death not only penetrates into their lungs, but also adheres to every inch of their skin.
And they didn't know whether the ones still alive in the quiet blood mist were their own people or those ferocious Dragon Feast followers.
Click...
Click...
In the cave filled with blood mist, sporadic footsteps began to be heard.
It was the sound of someone stepping on the gravel.
Wu held the stabbing sword in front of her to protect her younger brother behind her. At this moment, she was covered in scarlet red and her long hair was soaked in blood, but she didn't even dare to take a big breath and stared at the blood mist in front of her with all her concentration.
In comparison, Ning Yu was much calmer.
After she came to her senses, she quickly invoked the star runes and used the magic to draw away all the thick blood mist inside the cave. Then she ignited the runes' light to provide illumination.
In the cave where vision was restored, only seven or eight members of the Deacon Corps were still breathing. Most of them had fallen to the ground and were still in shock.
Only the leader was still standing there holding a long sword.
Half of his mask had been broken into pieces, revealing the vicissitudes of the left half of his face, as well as his eyes filled with heart palpitations.
He didn't know what happened just now. He only knew that a strange figure broke into the fighting group, and then Dragon Feast followers began to fall one after another.
The most frightening thing is that they were all killed with one knife, and they all fell in the same position - face down.
At this moment, the vision returned to clearness, and the team leader looked around in shock, only to find that all the Dragon Feast believers had only one fatal wound on the back of their corpses.
That was the effect of the blade penetrating through the back of the heart and stabbing directly through.
At this time, the team leader finally recalled what he saw in the blood mist.
He saw a figure running up to the back of the Dragon Feast believer at an extremely fast speed, stabbing him in the back with a knife, and then kicked the opponent in the knee. He pulled out the blade and without looking at the body, he ducked behind another Dragon Feast believer and repeated the same trick.
Then the third, the fourth, the fifth...
Just such a set of actions was repeated more than twenty times, and in less than a minute, all the Dragon Feast followers were killed.
During that time, it was not that there were no followers of Longfeng who attacked him in groups.
But the strange thing is that all the dragon bone blades slashing at that man...
None of it worked!
The team leader didn’t know if he had seen it wrong.
He clearly noticed that when the man was stabbing one of the believers in the back, the dragon bone blades of other Dragon Feast believers struck him several times, but they failed to cause any damage.
That man just seemed to be in an uninhabited land and slaughtered all the Dragon Feast believers in one breath.
The blood mist dissipated.
The leader, however, dared not relax his sword-holding hand.
Because the person who killed all the followers of Dragon Feast was the Dead Man, and at this moment he was walking around among the corpses, very close to him.
